It ships: Node 22 runtime via 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS node-runtime' + 'COPY --from=node-runtime /usr/local /usr/local' (L1,L4) on python:3.12-slim (python3 at /usr/local/bin/python3 for restart_mcp.py, score.py, probe_ready heredocs; those scripts import only stdlib incl. tomllib); util-linux/procps (L13) for setpriv/setsid/kill used by test.sh L99-111,L160-167; judge CLI '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281' and '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79' (L17,L19; playwright-mcp is the command in all five judge.toml files L11); app runtime deps 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' (L20-21) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (L9), matching solution/app/package.json dependencies (express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1), the agent image environment/Dockerfile L9-11, and environment/instructions/integration.md L3-4 ('Node 22 process with Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages'); 'harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7' pinned (L31); Chromium installed by the Playwright CLI bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (L33-38), which is the --executable-path in every judge.toml L12. The golden app requires only express, better-sqlite3 and node builtins (fs, path, crypto, http, worker_threads). Runtime (hashes verified by me): qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening/post-r3-permission-repair/validation.json records image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair (image sha256:e32bece...) built with 'docker build' from the task tests/ dir, with tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8... equal to the frozen bytes; build log local-attempt1/build-verifier.log (sha256 b4875d25... verified) shows exit 0 with all toolchain layers CACHED. configured-inspection.log in that attempt records in-image 'claude --version' -> '2.1.281 (Claude Code)', 'playwright-mcp --version' -> 'Version 0.0.79', 'node --version' -> 'v22.23.2', plus RewardKit discover/build_prompt import and configured CLI argument launch exit 0 (NO provider grade). raw-evidence-index.json entries (all 6 artifact hashes and all 12 matching frozen solution hashes verified equal) show qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs launching the frozen golden as uid 65534 in that same image, using the shipped playwright from /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@playwright/mcp/node_modules/playwright with executablePath /usr/local/bin/chromium (workspace.cjs L6,L283); server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (start + real restart). Adversarial: a conforming alternative that uses another npm package would not start in the verifier, but integration.md L3-4 explicitly limits the agent to Express/better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH, so that is not a false fail; a broken app cannot exploit the image. Residual risk (why risk=true): (1) no full configured test.sh/rewardkit grading run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope says full configured grading is absent), so 'can grade' end-to-end with the claude-code judge actually driving playwright-mcp is NOT EXERCISED; (2) the image evidence comes from a cached build; base images python:3.12-slim and node:22-bookworm-slim are tag- not digest-pinned and Chromium is pinned only transitively through @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, so a fresh uncached build is unmeasured. These are template-controlled and not task defects; do not edit the Dockerfile.
